message.content:
Small text-correction fix on branch `feature/SFCC-236_product-card-shared-component` in `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa`, approved by Marcel. **The problem:** the real Figma text node for `ZimmSizeChipGroup`'s single-size label (node `40003066:34855`, inside the "Type=One Size" variant `40003066:34866`) reads exactly **"One size"** — capital O, lowercase "size" — confirmed via a direct `get_design_context` pull that returned the literal text `

One size

`. Two files currently hardcode the wrong casing, **"One Size"** (capital S), as the actual data/fixture value (not just a description): 1. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSizeChipGroup/index.stories.tsx` — line 68, the `OneSize` story's own args: `values: [{ value: 'os', label: 'One Size' }]`. Change the `label` value to `'One size'`. 2. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSizeChipGroup/index.test.tsx` — the `'ZimmSizeChipGroup — One Size'` describe block (around lines 48-60): the fixture `val('os', 'One Size')` (appears twice) and the two `screen.getByText('One Size')` assertions. Change every one of these four occurrences of the string `'One Size'` to `'One size'`. **Do NOT touch:** - The `describe('ZimmSizeChipGroup — One Size', ...)` block's own name/title, or the test names like `'clicking around the One Size label calls nothing'` — these are test/describe *labels* (identifiers for humans reading test output), not the rendered text data, and "One Size" is a perfectly normal way to title a test section. Only change the actual string literal values being rendered/asserted against. - `zimmSizeChipGroup.css.ts`'s or `zimmSizeChipGroup.css.test.ts`'s references to `"Type=One Size"` — that's Figma's own component-variant name, a completely different string from the rendered label text, and is correctly cased as Figma names it. - Anything else in either file. When done, quote the exact before/after for both files, confirm `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean, and run `npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSizeChipGroup/index.test.tsx` to confirm it still passes (it must — you're changing both the fixture and its matching assertion together, so nothing should break). Do not stage, do not commit.
